description: This file defines the FoilEngine class implementing the Symfony EngineInterface for rendering templates in the Goteo application. It provides methods to render templates, check their existence, and support status.

classes.name: FoilEngine
classes.description: A class implementing TwigEngine to facilitate template rendering within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template by delegating to View::render with the provided name and parameters.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists by verifying that View::render does not return an empty string.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if a template is supported, based on its existence.
